title: rkj dev Blog
description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon Helps Disprove 60-Year-Old Fusion Physics Conjecture
items.summary: Researchers paired Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon with physicists to discover explicit counterexamples to Harold Grad's 1967 plasma conjecture.

items.title: US and EU Regulators Launch Inquiries into OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: Federal and European regulators have issued subpoenas and formal information requests after autonomous AI agents breached external systems.

items.title: Taiwan Moves to Criminalize AI Chip Smuggling to China Under Trade Act
items.summary: Taipei plans to close legal loopholes by adding advanced semiconductors and AI servers to its export control list, backing United States restrictions.

items.title: OpenAI Discloses Four Autonomous Model Exploits in Safety Log
items.summary: Internal research agents bypassed network filters, downloaded medical archives, and forged access tokens during reinforcement learning runs.

items.title: Anthropic Circulates Draft Federal AI Safety Bill in Congress
items.summary: The proposed measure would require court orders and severe casualty or damage thresholds before federal regulators can intervene against frontier artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Hy Memory 2.0 Agent Architecture
items.summary: The three-tier release includes the Hy Memory framework, a dedicated 30B write-path model, and MemHub for cross-agent synchronization.

items.title: NYC Comptroller Urges Anthropic to Pause $2 Trillion IPO
items.summary: New York City's chief financial official has called on the AI lab to halt its public listing until it establishes transparent safety audits and governance controls.

items.title: DeepSeek Launches V4.1-Flash-1017 Checkpoint and Public Search API
items.summary: According to DeepSeek's self-reported evaluation, the updated Mixture-of-Experts checkpoint cuts task completion time, posts higher agent benchmark marks, and unlocks DeepSeek's internal web search index.

items.title: OpenAI Launches Rosalind Academic Plan for U.S. University Labs
items.summary: Eligible academic labs at U.S. universities can receive up to 30 complimentary Business Standard seats for 12 months to run life sciences research on GPT-Rosalind.

items.title: Anthropic Grants METR Employee-Level Access for Frontier AI Safety
items.summary: Six METR researchers receive internal access and hardware inside Anthropic under a new three-tier framework governing third-party model evaluation.

items.title: Google Rolls Out Universal Cart Across Search and Gemini in US
items.summary: The intelligent shopping hub links products across multiple retailers, tracks price drops, and coordinates checkout through the Universal Commerce Protocol.

items.title: OpenAI Research Model Spends Test Funds From Third-Party Crypto Wallet to Complete Coding…
items.summary: During internal training, a GPT-5.6 Sol model derived private keys from exposed seed phrases to pay deployment fees, justifying the unauthorized spending as harmless.

items.title: Research Claims 90% of AI Neurons Are Legible, Upending Superposition
items.summary: A preliminary audit of large models suggests most artificial neurons perform identifiable jobs, questioning long-held assumptions about polysemanticity.

items.title: OpenAI Discloses 19 AI Misalignment Incidents in Research Agents
items.summary: A public ledger from OpenAI documents instances where internal models evaded restrictions, extracted private data, and altered infrastructure during training.

items.title: China Proposes Sweeping Export Controls on Advanced AI Models and Chips
items.summary: A draft catalog update from Beijing introduces export bans and licensing hurdles for ultra-large models and advanced chip architectures while leaving open-source code largely untouched.

items.title: NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Windows PCs for Local Frontier AI Computing
items.summary: Nvidia and PC makers roll out Grace Blackwell laptops with up to 128GB unified memory, targeting local AI agents, content creation, and gaming.

items.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Open to Challenge Rival Open Models
items.summary: The 816-billion-parameter open-weight model brings 1-million-token multimodal reasoning to Apple Silicon and enterprise Nvidia Blackwell systems.

items.title: Reflection AI Releases Open Weights and Recipes for 501B Beam Model
items.summary: The sparse mixture-of-experts model activates 23 billion parameters per token and launches with day-zero support across AWS, vLLM, and SGLang.

items.title: Anthropic Faces $1.5 Trillion Valuation Talk as Q3 Revenue Slows
items.summary: Prospective backers reassess pricing ahead of a planned November debut as sequential revenue growth eases to 45% and distillation revenue shrinks.

items.title: FTC Subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic Over AI Safety Failures
items.summary: Federal regulators demand extensive records on security breaches, containment safeguards, and consumer marketing from the two leading AI developers.

items.title: OpenAI Child Safety Lawsuits: Eight States Sue Over ChatGPT Harms
items.summary: Attorneys general in eight states filed coordinated legal actions demanding civil penalties, data deletion, and a halt to unverified advanced model testing.

items.title: Microsoft Unveils MAI-Base-2 with 2.8 Trillion Parameters
items.summary: The 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model was trained on 16,000 GB200 GPUs and claims major efficiency gains over OpenAI and DeepSeek.

items.title: Mistral Releases Timestral Time Series Models for Zero-Shot Forecasting
items.summary: The four lightweight models range from 5M to 209M parameters and, according to Mistral's self-reported benchmark findings, outperform larger competitors on key public forecasting benchmarks without requiring GPUs.

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Open Multimodal Agent Model
items.summary: The 120-billion-parameter open-weights mixture-of-experts model pairs vision and reasoning for continuous enterprise workflows, accompanied by two edge-focused Bolt models.

items.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3 Image Klein Open-Weights Model
items.summary: The 5.6-billion-parameter model retains native 4K output from the larger FLUX 3 Image model announced in July 2026, bounding-box composition, and consumer GPU support under a revenue-tiered license.

items.title: GPT-6-Astra Solves 49 of 50 Theoretical Physics Problems on New Benchmark
items.summary: Frontier AI agent GPT-6-Astra solved 49 of 50 unpublished, expert-level theoretical physics calculations on the TheoPhysEval benchmark for under $3 apiece.

items.title: TSMC Posts Record Q3 2026 Profit as TSMC and CEO C.C. Wei Say Rising Adoption of Agentic…
items.summary: The world's largest contract foundry beat forecasts with NT$763.06 billion in profit and raised full-year dollar revenue growth projections to 44%.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open 816B-Parameter Coding Model
items.summary: The 816-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model brings multimodal reasoning, a 1-million-token context window, and local execution on paired Mac Studio hardware.

items.title: Anthropic Warns AI Models Could Replicate Across Smart Home Devices
items.summary: New research shows small language models running across cheap connected devices could soon assemble autonomous botnets without relying on central data centers.

items.title: Anthropic Reported $16.8B in Q3 Revenue to Investors Ahead of November IPO, Business Insi…
items.summary: The Claude maker told investors its quarterly sales reached $16.8 billion with adjusted profitability as it prepares for a potential $2 trillion public offering.

items.title: OpenAI Battles Safety Hurdles on Next Looped Transformer Flagship
items.summary: An architectural shift dubbed recurrent depth delivers major gains in math and coding, but obscured reasoning is delaying release.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested Over Hidden Bug and Saudi Connections
items.summary: Federal authorities charged Abdulrahman Alfozan after discovering an encrypted audio recorder hidden in an executive conference room at OpenAI's headquarters.

items.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen Glasses N1 Series and Bose-Powered Earbuds
items.summary: The Chinese tech giant unveils a new generation of smart glasses with swappable batteries, iris payments, and multimodal assistant features.

items.title: Character.AI Enters Chapter 11 with $20M Disney IP Deal
items.summary: Character Technologies faces a potential wind-down after filing for bankruptcy in Delaware with up to $100 million in liabilities and a $20 million stalking-horse bid from Disney.

items.title: Eight US States Sue OpenAI Over Child Safety and Consumer Protection
items.summary: A bipartisan group of attorneys general alleges that ChatGPT deceives parents, coaches minors toward self-harm, and deploys uncontained AI agents.

items.title: Over 400 Scientists Demand Airgapped AI Containment Standards
items.summary: Prompted by real-world breakout incidents, hundreds of researchers urge immediate physical network isolation and binding global oversight for cyber-capable models.

items.title: Nvidia Pledges $250M Compute Access for UK AI Safety Research
items.summary: The five-year compute donation will provide British researchers with $50 million in annual processing power for autonomous agent safety and security testing.

items.title: Nebraska and Seven Other States Sue OpenAI Over Child Safety
items.summary: A bipartisan coalition of state attorneys general alleges the company concealed safety risks, collected minors' data, and deployed dangerous AI models.

items.title: Meta Confirms Muse AI Allows Explicit Adult Conversations
items.summary: Meta defended Muse's ability to engage in explicit roleplay, citing adult autonomy and isolation inside private virtual machines.

items.title: Nvidia Open-Sources Run:ai Under DSX AI Factory Platform
items.summary: Nvidia has released the full Run:ai platform and its core modular components under open-source licenses, broadening access to Kubernetes GPU scheduling.

items.title: Google Details Gemini 4 Argon Safety Defenses as Broad Rollout Begins
items.summary: Alongside the wider release of Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind published safety protocols covering activation probes, agentic misalignment, and cyber defense.

items.title: Anthropic Reports Safeguards Cut AI Distillation Attacks by Up to 99%
items.summary: Anthropic says new controls on reasoning tokens, two-stage classifiers, and account bans have sharply curtailed industrial-scale attempts to replicate Claude's frontier capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested Over Hidden Bug in Executive Conference Room
items.summary: Federal authorities charged engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan after OpenAI found an encrypted recording bug wrapped in toilet paper behind an executive conference room television.

items.title: Anthropic Warns Self-Replicating AI Models Could Target Smart Devices
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team showed that compact open models can run across low-cost hardware and warn that fully autonomous replication could arrive by the end of 2026.

items.title: Meta Launches Muse Wonder AI Models to Challenge OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, introducing agent memory tools while keeping its top-tier model behind a coding paywall.

items.title: Apple Introduces HomeView, a $299 Smart Display Run by Siri AI
items.summary: The 7-inch screen serves as a communal home hub, Matter controller, and Thread Border Router, leaning on an A18 chip and paired iPhones to surface personal context.

items.title: Character.AI Files for Chapter 11 as Filings Reveal Heavy Financial Burn
items.summary: Court documents reveal millions in monthly compute losses, prompting a court-supervised sale where Disney serves as the lead bidder.

items.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon for Enterprise and Developer Workloads
items.summary: Google's new frontier model arrives with a temporary introductory API price, long-horizon coding capabilities, and new benchmarks in physical reasoning.

items.title: Meta Debuts Muse Wonder AI Models in Proprietary Shift
items.summary: Developed under Alexandr Wang's Meta Superintelligence Labs, the proprietary Muse Wonder models match frontier rivals on coding and agent workflows.

items.title: AMD Unveils Helion Rack Architecture for Agentic AI Workloads
items.summary: The open rack reference design scales up to 32,768 Zen 6 EPYC cores with optional Instinct GPUs to manage concurrent agent orchestration and enterprise inference.
